autostart.denied: Windows refused to change autostart (access denied). The setting is unchanged.
autostart.disabledByUser: Autostart is turned off in Task Manager (Startup apps). Turn VPN Tunnel Enforcer on there to start it when you sign in to Windows.
autostart.stateUnknown: Autostart state is unknown: the change failed and the previous setting could not be restored. Check VPN Tunnel Enforcer in Task Manager under Startup apps.
